name: Wikiracer
summary: Race between Wikipedia articles using only their links, then watch the shortest route being found.
description: Get from one Wikipedia article to another in as few clicks as you can. At the finish, a search spreads out from both articles at once, you watch the two fronts meet, and your route appears beside the shortest one. I turned Wikipedia's 11 GB of SQL dumps into a map of 7 million articles and 713 million links that the browser can search by reading about a megabyte of it, with no search server. There's a daily course, random courses at three difficulties and live rooms for racing friends.

image.alt: A finished Wikiracer race: two search fronts meeting in the middle, with my route shown against the shortest one.
